ValidationRule.description: Multi região. Controla os campos obrigatórios de endereço por região.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR ( AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'SA', BillingCountry = 'Brasil', NOT( ISPICKVAL(AccountSource, 'Market Place') ), OR( ISBLANK(BillingCity ), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(TEXT(BillingType__c)), ISBLANK(BillingAddress), ISBLANK(BillingState), ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCountry) ) ), AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Supplier', OR( ISBLANK(BillingCity ), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(TEXT(BillingType__c)), ISBLANK(BillingAddress), ISBLANK(BillingState), ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCountry) ) ), AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NACA', OR( ISBLANK(BillingCity ), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(BillingAddress), ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCountry) ) ), AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'EMEA', OR( ISBLANK(BillingCity ), ISBLANK(BillingAddress), ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCountry) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: É obrigatório o preenchimento dos dados de endereço de cobrança.
